hints.title: Total Movement Configurations
hints.text: Each of the n monkeys has 2 movement choices, giving 2^n total movement configurations.

hints.title: Non-Colliding Outcomes
hints.text: A collision does not occur if and only if all monkeys move in the exact same direction: all clockwise, or all counter-clockwise.

hints.title: Complement Modular Exponentiation
hints.text: Subtract the 2 non-colliding configurations from 2^n modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Modular Exponentiation Collision Implementation

variables: n: number of vertices and monkeys
complexity.notes: Binary modular exponentiation in logarithmic steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Calculating 2^n with iterative multiplication takes O(n) which exceeds time limits for n = 10^9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies complementary counting 2^n - 2 with fast modular exponentiation.
